# Python toolchain baked into the CI runner image (.github/docker/ci-runner.Dockerfile).
#
# One line per package the non-VM workflow jobs install today. ruff and dnspython carry
# the repo's OWN pins (test.yml / tests/smoke/requirements.txt) and
# tests/test_ci_runner_images.py fails if either drifts from its source of truth. The
# rest were floating `pip install <name>` calls whose verdict tracked whatever PyPI
# served that morning; they are frozen here at the versions CI resolved when the image
# was introduced, so a gate now moves in a reviewable diff.

# Lint + format gate (pin restated from test.yml's ruff job).
ruff==0.16.0

# Type gate for tests/ (config in pyproject.toml).
mypy==2.3.0

# The pytest matrix leg and its informational branch-coverage run.
pytest==9.1.1
pytest-cov==7.1.0

# Import-time deps that decide whether tests RUN or importorskip-skip:
# dnspython is the shard-splitter's end-to-end correctness gate (issue #861) and is
# pinned to the same version tests/smoke/requirements.txt installs; charset-normalizer
# lets the issue #1797 feed-encoding converter test execute.
dnspython==2.8.0
charset-normalizer==3.4.9

# The manual-only `benchmarks` job (test.yml, workflow_dispatch + run_benchmarks) installs
# benchmarks/requirements.txt. Pinned there, restated here so a dispatched benchmark run
# does not have to reach PyPI — and so this file's "every package the non-VM jobs
# install" claim is actually true. tests/test_ci_runner_images.py pins the agreement.
pytest-benchmark==5.2.3
pympler==1.1
pygments==2.20.0
